check_dummies: check if dummy files are up to date and raise an error if the main __init__ has new objects
check_dummies_fix: check dummy files and overwrite them with updated content when the main __init__ has new objects
read_init: read the __init__ file and extract backend-specific objects like PyTorch, TensorFlow, and SentencePiece modules
create_dummy_files: create dummy file content for backend-specific objects parsed from the main __init__
create_dummy_object: create the code for a dummy constant, class, or function corresponding to a given name and backend
